text:
emma (security): heads up: nightly audit found ~2k objects in staging lacking CMK headers. tagging encops/sre.
infra-bot: ALERT storage-audit: 2,021 objects missing SSE-KMS metadata in s3://redwood-staging/backups/2026-03 (rule: require-cmek)

ryan (encops): any recent infra changes around uploader or webhook?

vijay (platform): yeswe ran a quick rollback on uploader-chart on Mar 19. a kyverno mutating webhook that injects cmk headers was disabled and not reapplied.

ana (sre): can confirm head-object shows no x-amz-server-side-encryption header -> objects are unencrypted.

emma (security): priority: stop additional bad uploads, enumerate tenants, and plan re-encryption. compliance notified.

ryan (encops): proposed plan:
1) admission deny for uploader namespace to stop writes
2) redeploy webhook and force uploader with CMEK=true
3) rewriter job: ephemeral KMS grant + S3 copy-with-SSE-KMS, manifest logged to compliance bucket
4) special handling for old multipart uploads

vijay (platform): i'll push emergency PR to re-enable webhook and add infra-lint rule to block CMEK=false in staging/prod charts. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/499

ana (sre): running dry-run list now: 1,907 simple objects, 114 multipart legacy. starting batch-1 (500). i'll validate a sample restore post-copy.

emma (security): ensure each copy records operator + correlation id. postmortem: require IAM-prune sign-off and webhook healthcheck.

ryan (encops): starting grant G-abc123 for batch-1. will revoke on completion and attach logs to INC-20260322-02.

infra-bot: mitigation applied: uploader webhook re-enabled at 20:12 UTC. incident INC-20260322-02 opened.
